prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Companion"]
1: ["Quick Desktop Shortcuts", "Learn how to summon, move, and chat with your pet anywhere on your desktop screen.", "Got It!"]
2: ["Did you know? You can drag your pet anywhere on screen!"]
3: ["Preview Your Custom Pet", "Check how your uploaded pet image will render on your desktop background.", "Looks Great!"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Keep your pet safe and accessible across sessions. Protect your companion from accidental resets.", "Continue with Account"]
5: ["Preparing Pet for Desktop Launch...", "Your companion is rendering and getting ready to jump onto your desktop."]
6: ["Welcome Home! Free Companion Item Unlocked", "Your pet is now active on your desktop with a special launch reward!", "Launch Reward Unlocked"]
7: ["Preset companions launch instantly! Custom photo pets take under 2 minutes."]
8: ["Pet active! Check your taskbar or main monitor if hidden behind full-screen windows.", "Desktop Pet Active"]
9: ["Bring Your Desktop to Life", "Adopt a virtual companion that lives on your desktop, reacts to your day, and keeps you company.", "Start Adoption Journey"]
